children: Yiteng Jiahua Pharma (06998) said Chairman Ni Xin plans to use personal funds to increase his stake in the open market by up to $1 million, starting August 31, according to ETNet.

On the same day, the company said it had launched a share buyback programme. The repurchased shares will be used for employee incentives and market value management. The blackout period for interim results ended on August 28.

title: Yiteng Jiahua Pharma Chairman Plans Up To $1 Million Share Buy
